title: Credit Card Approval Prediction (CreditGuard AI)
summary: An end-to-end Machine Learning solution evaluating credit applicant delinquency risk with explainable AI and automated CI/CD testing.
problem: Financial institutions face high credit default rates due to inaccurate risk profiling and imbalanced applicant data.
solution: Developed a machine learning classification engine using XGBoost and SMOTE oversampling to accurately detect high-risk applicants.
contribution: Built custom data preprocessing pipelines, SMOTE oversampling, interactive Flask dashboard, and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows.
features: Designed custom preprocessing pipelines & SMOTE-oversampling, achieving 66.67% delinquency recall.
Built interactive prediction and metrics dashboards using Flask and Bootstrap 5 with Dark/Light modes.
Configured automated MLOps CI/CD via GitHub Actions for testing, lints, Docker builds, and Pages deployment.
verifiedResult: 66.67% Delinquency Recall with automated CI/CD test suite

title: FarmaLink-AI
summary: A Next.js 15 + React 19 agricultural SaaS platform connecting farmers directly with buyers, logistics networks, and cold storages.
problem: Agricultural supply chains suffer from intermediary price exploitation, lack of crop disease diagnostics, and opaque transaction escrow.
solution: Engineered a platform featuring AI disease diagnostics, crop yield/price prediction, and simulated escrow transaction wallets.
contribution: Architected Next.js 15 App Router pages, Prisma + Supabase schema definitions, Zustand store state management, and production CI/CD check guards.
features: Designed AI-powered disease diagnostics, price prediction simulations, and real-time escrow wallet transactions.
Stabilized production CI/CD check pipelines, ESM migrations, and Next.js App Router middleware guards.

title: AI Interview Coach Pro
summary: AI-powered interview simulator with real-time feedback.
problem: Candidates struggle to get real-time actionable feedback on technical interview performance.
solution: Built an interactive AI mock interview platform providing instant feedback on technical accuracy and communication.
